This plot is rented, so I am careful not to spend too much on it — the land is not mine to improve for the long term. The crop here is not one of the main cereals that get the fertilizer package from the cooperative, and with no schooling I stick to what my father taught me. I have cattle at home, so I will carry manure to the plot. I will work it myself with my family and only bring one or two helpers at weeding and harvest time.
